title: benchmark:materialize fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND on its own .ts imports
description:
`pnpm run benchmark:materialize` is the supported path for materializing a pinned corpus packet. On current `develop` (Node 22.22) it fails with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` on its own TypeScript imports.

`tests/benchmark/scripts/materialize-repo.mjs` is launched as

```
node --experimental-strip-types tests/benchmark/scripts/materialize-repo.mjs
```

and imports `../materialize-paths.ts` and `../materialize-orchestrator.ts`. Those `.ts` specifiers do not resolve as modules under Node 22.22, so nobody can materialize a packet through the supported path.

This blocks the detection census and the baseline run. It does not authorize detector retuning, new language ingest, or skipping tests.

Definition of done: `pnpm run benchmark:materialize <repo-key>` works on the Node version CI and contributors use; existing materialize unit tests stay green; no test is skipped, disabled, or quarantined.

comments.author: rap@endymion.com
comments.text:
## Root cause
`benchmark:materialize` ran `materialize-repo.mjs` with `node --experimental-strip-types`, importing `../materialize-paths.ts` and `../materialize-orchestrator.ts`. Node could load those `.ts` files, but `materialize-orchestrator.ts` imports `./materialize-paths` without an extension. Under ESM resolution (strip-types reparses the file as ESM), that inner import fails with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`.

## Fix
Match `benchmark:run`: compile with `tsc`, then execute the built JS.
- Converted `tests/benchmark/scripts/materialize-repo.mjs` → `materialize-repo.ts`
- Updated `package.json`: `pnpm run build && node dist/tests/benchmark/scripts/materialize-repo.js`
- Entrypoint uses `resolveDefaultBenchmarkRoot(__dirname)` so paths resolve correctly from `dist/`
- Added `tests/unit/benchmark/materialize-entrypoint.spec.ts` smoke test

## Proof
- `node dist/tests/benchmark/scripts/materialize-repo.js` → usage message, exit 1
- `pnpm run benchmark:materialize vgs-django` → materialized successfully
- `pnpm test tests/unit/benchmark/` → 3 suites, 8 tests, all green

PR: https://github.com/DataParade-io/scanner/pull/11
